rationale: The majority opinion is most likely assigned to the Chief or to a consensus-builder (Kagan/Kavanaugh) to articulate a narrow, case-tethered restitution/refund remedy that avoids “leveling up” and minimizes fiscal disruption while answering sovereign-immunity concerns.
